name: imager
description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI's GPT Image models, for Claude Code and Codex - gpt-image-2.5-flare, sunburst and gpt-image-2, 27 style presets, platform sizing for the places images actually go, transparent backgrounds, masked inpainting, carousels and photo edits. Drafts cost around $0.006, so the workflow iterates on drafts and only pays for the one you approved, it tells you the cost before it spends anything, and it records what was actually billed afterwards.
